pages.text: Dragon Blood Scent is a status effect that prevents an afflicted player from directly interacting with Dragons for the duration of the effect (typically 25 minutes). $(br2)The effect cannot be removed with milk or commands. Dying or waiting for the effect to end will remove the effect.
pages.title: Basic Information

pages.text: When a player is afflicted with the Dragon Blood Scent effect they cannot directly command, ride, or tame any Dragons for as long as the scent lingers. $(br2)Indirectly commanding Dragons with Dragon Command Items bypasses this effect
pages.title: Effect Information
